description: This file defines the SkeletonActivity class, which is an Android Activity demonstrating basic UI interactions such as menu handling, button clicks, and text editing with an EditText component.

classes.name: SkeletonActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating menu handling, button clicks, and text input.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components and button click listeners.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with back and clear options.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, toggling visibility of the 'clear' option based on text presence.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, performing actions like finishing activity or clearing text.

fields.name: BACK_ID
fields.description: Menu ID for the back option.

fields.name: CLEAR_ID
fields.description: Menu ID for the clear option.

fields.name: mEditor
fields.description: EditText UI component for displaying and editing text.

fields.name: mBackListener
fields.description: OnClickListener callback for the back button.

fields.name: mClearListener
fields.description: OnClickListener callback for the clear button.

methods.name: mBackListener
methods.description: Callback triggered when the back button is clicked; finishes the activity.

methods.name: mClearListener
methods.description: Callback triggered when the clear button is clicked; clears the text in mEditor.
